finalText:
**Redis went down and took prod with it.**

Root cause is at [app.log:182](logs/app.log:182). Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connects. All 13 reconnects failed over 17 minutes. Cache fell back to direct store reads. The store then overloaded with `TimeoutError` on every request.

Queue depth passed max 500 at 02:29. Then `worker-2` died of `JavaScript heap out of memory`. Supervisor killed `api` at 02:31:52. See [app.log:719](logs/app.log:719).

Next: check why Redis stopped at 02:14 UTC. Also cap the queue so backlog can't blow the heap.
